metric_definitions.avg_stopped_waiting_time_sec_completed: mean sampled stopped seconds among completed trips; NaN if none completed

metric_definitions.demand_completed: SUMO min expected vehicle count is zero at termination
metric_definitions.simulated_duration_sec: SUMO elapsed simulated seconds before horizon or no expected/active demand
metric_definitions.sumo_inserted_vehicles: SUMO departed count accumulated each simulation step
metric_definitions.time_weighted_avg_queue_vehicles: time average of NS+EW A1 inbound halting vehicles (speed <=0.1 m/s)
metric_definitions.total_stopped_waiting_time_sec_completed: sum of sampled stopped seconds for trips that completed; unfinished vehicles excluded

observation_reward_differences.original_dqn: same 18 state IDs, one-hot encoded by original agent; queue reward

observation_reward_differences.state_only_dqn: six raw normalized phase/queue features, unbounded counts divided by 20; queue reward
